title: validation_report
description: Machine-readable output of validate-kernel-pr. review-pr consumes this as the evidence base for any finding that asserts runtime behaviour. Fields that describe coverage are required precisely so a report cannot overclaim by omission.

label.description: Run identifier, e.g. the PR number or a candidate name.

started_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at run start.

isolation.description: The isolation actually achieved, not the isolation intended.

reason.description: Why the level is what it is, when it is not container-level.

arch_coverage.description: Per-architecture coverage. 'runtime' means kernels were executed on that device; 'compile-only' means they were built for it and never run. A host without a device for an arch must report compile-only for it.

examples.gfx942: compile-only (no gfx942 device on this host)

degraded_mode.description: Set when no GPU could be claimed. Every downstream correctness/perf claim is then unbacked and must be read as [compile-only validation].

stages.description: One entry per stage. A stage that could not run reports 'skip' with a note; it never reports 'pass' for work it did not do.

log.description: Path to the retained stage log.

merge_sim.description: PR head applied onto the current base; conflict short-circuits the run.

gpu_claim.description: GPU claimed over a sampling window and held under flock for the whole run.

hip_index.description: Translated HIP index; amd-smi numbering can differ.

runtime_compat.description: Whether the checkout imports against the installed runtime. A mismatch is reported as such, not attributed to the PR.

test_policy.description: Checks run BEFORE the suite, because a suite that cannot fail still reports green.

loosened.description: (base, head) pairs where this change widened a tolerance.

correctness_repo_tests.description: The suite the PR itself ships.

correctness_s1_grid.description: A shape grid this skill owns, independent of what the PR chose to test: non-toy, boundary/odd, long-context. 'skip' with repo-default-only when the kernel exposes no shape override.

index_width_scan.description: Structural candidates for 32-bit index/stride overflow. Informational: the reviewer judges each, the count does not move the verdict.

perf.description: Median-of-N against baseline on the same locked GPU. Absent when not run.

claims.description: Reproduction of the performance numbers stated in the PR description. A number that does not reproduce is tagged [unreproducible] rather than dropped.

findings.description: Machine-generated findings from the stages above. These are evidence, not review prose; review-pr turns them into reviewer-facing findings.

verdict.description: Covers only what ran. Read together with arch_coverage, isolation and degraded_mode: a PASS on a compile-only run asserts nothing about runtime behaviour.
